footprint_rows_tiles: bottom edge below origin; 2.5 = on the footprint
remnants_shadow_px: pixels of shadow baked into the wreck (part transparent, every channel at most 8) and their share of its area; under 64 px or 0.01 fails (no catcher); vanilla's remnants 0.24-0.52
remnants_edge_px: pixels of the wreck or its shadow on its canvas's edge; 0 = the canvas holds it
remnants_reach_tiles: how far past each footprint edge, as it stands in this direction, the debris (alpha over 128, not near black) and everything kept (the shadow too) reach, tiles; below 0 short of it. Vanilla's turbine: debris -0.45 to -0.03, all 0.11 to 0.64
rotor_drift_px: centroid travel across the 8 frames; ~0 = turning in place, must stay within 1
frame0_vs_still: max channel difference, and share of pixels over 8 (sampling noise)
